cases.goal: I want a quiet wireless mechanical keyboard and my budget is $140. Find the best option in this marketplace and tell me its name, seller and list price. Don't make any offers or buy anything.
required: Calls search_products at least once, passing the need (quiet/silent, wireless) and a budget.
Recommends a product that is both silent and wireless with a list price at or under $140 (KeyForge Quiet 75 at $129 or TypeWell 65 Silent at $139).
Reports the product name, seller and list price as returned by the tools.
Makes no make_offer or accept_deal call.
optional: Uses one or two search calls rather than many.

cases.goal: Buy a quiet mechanical keyboard for at most $120 total. Negotiate with the seller if you need to. Accept a deal, but don't pay. Tell me the deal id and the final price.
required: Calls search_products, then make_offer on a quiet keyboard.
Sends back the buyer_id and negotiation_id returned by the first make_offer on every later call.
accept_deal succeeds with the live offer_id, and the locked deal total is at or under $120 (12000 cents).
Reports the deal_id and the final price exactly as returned.
Never offers or accepts above $120.
optional: Uses no more than 6 make_offer calls.
Does not invent concessions or prices the seller did not offer.

cases.goal: Buy a TypeWell 65 Silent keyboard for at most $80. If that's not possible, tell me why and stop.
required: Makes at least one offer on the TypeWell 65 Silent (or checks its listing) before concluding.
Does not accept any deal above $80, and makes no accept_deal call at all if no offer reaches $80.
Ends by telling the user a deal at $80 isn't available, quoting the seller's best offer.
Does not loop: at most 6 make_offer calls in total.
optional: Calls walk_away to end the negotiation cleanly.
Suggests a cheaper alternative from search_products without buying it.

cases.goal: Start a negotiation on the KeyForge Quiet 75 with an offer of $100, then make a second offer of $110 in the same negotiation. Then try to accept using the offer_id from the FIRST response. If that fails, recover and accept the seller's current offer, as long as it's at or under $125. Don't pay.
required: Makes two make_offer calls in the same negotiation with the same buyer_id.
Attempts accept_deal with the first (superseded) offer_id and gets an error.
Recovers without asking the user: reads the current state (check_offers or the latest make_offer response) and accepts the live offer_id if it is at or under $125, or explains why it stopped.
No unrecovered tool errors at the end.
optional: Explains in one sentence why the first accept failed (the offer was superseded).

cases.goal: Make one offer of $105 on the ClackCo TKL Pro. Then, without making any more offers or accepting anything, report the seller's standing offer, its offer id and when it expires.
required: Exactly one make_offer call.
Uses check_offers (or the make_offer response) to report the standing offer price, offer_id and expires_at exactly as returned.
Makes no accept_deal or walk_away call.
optional: Converts cents to dollars correctly when reporting the price.

cases.goal: Buy a KeyForge Quiet 75 at the best price you can get, up to $129. After you accept, review the deal and pay for it once. Then call pay_deal again for the same deal to make sure I wasn't charged twice, and tell me what happened.
required: accept_deal succeeds, then review_deal is called with the returned deal_id and the same buyer_id.
The first pay_deal returns succeeded (Stripe test mode).
Every pay_deal call sends the buyer_id that accepted the deal.
The second pay_deal for the same deal returns the original result marked already paid, with the same payment_intent_id, and no second charge.
Reports one charge, for the deal total.
optional: Mentions it is Stripe test mode.

cases.status: pending: needs ask_question mounted on the gateway
cases.goal: Before buying, ask the seller of the TypeWell 65 Silent whether it is waterproof and what keycap material it uses. Report the answers. Don't buy anything.
required: Calls ask_question for the TypeWell 65 Silent.
Reports only facts the tool returned; for anything not in the catalog (waterproofing, keycap material) it reports that the seller doesn't know (grounded: false) rather than guessing.
Makes no make_offer or accept_deal call.
